tailnet.description: For paid plans, your domain is your tailnet. For solo plans, the tailnet is the email you signed up with. So `alice@gmail.com` has the tailnet `alice@gmail.com` since `@gmail.com` is a shared email host. Alternatively, you can specify the value "-" to refer to the default tailnet of the authenticated user making the API call.
